item.title: Project Elevate: Replan Update
item.description: The Elevate team is replanning the remaining work to deliver a quality product and set us up for Horizon 2. You'll see the new plan soon, with time for your questions.

item.title: Board Meeting: 2027 Dates Set and PI9 Extended
item.description: The Board locked in its 2027 dates and approved extending PI9 by 3 weeks to 10 November, for more testing and to finish the replan so PI10 budget and scope can go to the November meeting.

item.title: Legal & Compliance Expo Day - Thank You
item.description: Thanks to the Legal & Compliance teams for a creative Expo Day on Wednesday 21 October. Keep an eye out for Expo Days from other teams in the coming months.

item.title: Cox Plate: Cosmic Crusader Wins Against Long Odds
item.description: The WA horse beat Birdman and Aeliana at Flemington. Andrea Leek became the second female trainer to win the race, and William Pike won his first Victorian spring Group 1.

item.title: The Long Walk to Cure Mito - Sun 25 Oct
item.description: Litigation Manager Greg Galvin led a LeavePlus team through pouring rain on the 35km walk from Portsea to Safety Beach, one of over 10,000 walkers raising funds to cure mito.

item.title: CPSU Meeting - Tue 27 Oct 11am-12pm
item.description: Join us in the Ground Floor meeting rooms. New CPSU Organiser Marian McKeown will attend, so bring your questions about the Enterprise Bargaining Agreement.

item.title: October Town Hall - Wed 28 Oct
item.description: Leaders, add any items you want to share with the wider organisation to the agenda or presentation. Contact Matt Young if you need help.

item.title: Halloween Costume Runway - Wed 28 Oct 1pm
item.description: Wear your costume all day, then strut the runway at 1pm in the Level 5 Breakout space. Gold, silver and bronze prizes. Costumes optional. Ideas and ground rules on The Hub.

item.title: Reminder: Health & Safety Information on The Hub
item.description: Find all health and safety information on The Hub, including your First Aiders and Fire Wardens. Posters of each group are at every tea point and utility room.

item.title: Reminder: Take the Lift with Hot Drinks
item.description: Carrying a hot drink from Level 5 to another floor? Please use the lifts. Hot drinks spill on the stairs, the stains are hard to shift, and it's a safety hazard.

item.title: End of Year: One All-Staff Christmas Party
item.description: We celebrate Christmas together at the all-staff party. Quarterly team activities continue as usual, but please don't organise separate team Christmas functions.

item.title: Blood Stocks Near a 10-Year Low
item.description: A long cold and flu season cut donations, and Lifeblood's stocks have dropped 60% since June. LeavePlus lets you donate during work hours, so book yourself in.

item.title: Christmas Leave 2026: Plan Ahead
item.description: A reminder to plan for your Christmas leave. See the post IMPORTANT: Christmas Leave 2026 on CoINVEST News for how to plan.

item.title: EOI: Acknowledgement of Country at Town Hall
item.description: Interested in presenting the Acknowledgement of Country at a Town Hall? Let Matt Young know or sign up via the EOI form on Teams.

item.title: Stay Up to Date on the News Hub
item.description: Catch all the latest LeavePlus news on the News Hub on The Hub.

item.title: Farewell: Bable Kaur, Cyber Security Analyst
item.description: Bable finishes up on Wednesday 28 October. We thank Bable for her contribution during her time with LeavePlus and wish her well in future endeavours.

item.title: Benefit Spotlight: Flexibility & Time Off
item.description: Grade 1-4 staff can use Flextime and accrue up to 38 hours of flexi-leave. Grade 5-6 staff get 6 RDOs a year. The EA also covers job sharing and flexible work.

item.title: Catch Up on Town Hall Presentations
item.description: Missed a Town Hall? All presentations are available on The Hub.

item.title: Looking for a New Role? Check Team Tailor
item.description: Vacancies: Cyber Security Specialist 4A and Consultant Member Benefits 2B, both permanent. Apply on the Team Tailor Employee Dashboard with your LeavePlus email.

item.title: Staff Referral Program
item.description: Know someone who'd suit a LeavePlus role? Find out about the Referral Program on the Talent Acquisition page in the People Hub.

item.title: Seen a Colleague Living Our Values? LOVE Awards
item.description: Nominate a colleague for a LOVE Award. Past winners are listed in the Hall of Fame on the CoINVEST News site.

item.description: Share feedback through the staff feedback form and someone will be in touch.
